concerns.text: The plan asserts that the full sweep of 90 runs (3 α × 3 ε × 10 seeds) will complete within a 5.5 hour wall‑clock budget on the GitHub Actions free‑tier runner (2 vCPU, ~7 GB RAM). Given the CPU‑only Opacus DP overhead, the need to train a tiny CNN across many clients per round, and the total of up to 1,350 communication rounds, this runtime estimate is overly optimistic and likely exceeds the free‑tier compute budget, making the experiment infeasible under the stated constraints.
